verdict.rationale: Forter's documentation shows it returns fraud or abuse decisions at checkout (forter-docs-1), and an MCP server can review decisions. Nothing in the pack shows that decisions or scores come with top risk factors, reason codes, or any other explanation of why a transaction looks risky. Explainability is a fair question for a fraud-decisioning product, so the lack of evidence makes this 'none', not 'na'.

support.subject: As a risk analyst, every score comes with its top risk factors — why this transaction looks risky — not just an opaque number
